boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The box office is closed on non-event days. It opens two hours before show time on event days. To purchase tickets in advance, in person, please visit the Schottenstein Center Ticket Office Mon-Fri: 9AM-4PM.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Visa, MasterCard, American Express and Discover – cash NOT accepted
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call tickets can be picked up at the Mershon Auditorium ticket office starting two hours before show time on event day.

venues.parkingDetail: Day of Event parking may be available in the Arps Garage at 1990 College Rd. (accessible off 18th or College Rd.) or the Ohio Union South Garage at 1780 College Rd. (accessible off High St.). Credit or Debit ONLY. To purchase advanced parking go to https://campusparc.parkmobile.io/mershon-auditorium.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Tickets are available at all prices (while supplies last) and can be purchased at Ticketmaster or the Schottenstein Center Ticket Office. PLEASE NOTE: Mershon Auditorium does not have an elevator to the balcony.

generalInfo.generalRule: No audio or video recording permitted. Photo policies are determined by the show. Selfie sticks and iPads are prohibited. Devices will not be permitted to interfere with other guests views. Bags are NOT permitted except medical or diaper bags. Clutches no larger than 8x5x1 are permitted. We suggest leaving most items at home. No outside food or beverages. All guests are subject to security screenings. If prohibited items are found, guests may return them to their vehicle or surrender without return.
generalInfo.childRule: Children under two years may enter without a ticket but must sit on the lap of a parent/guardian. Rules for children vary for other events at Mershon Auditorium. Check individual show for more information.

venues.name: Nationwide Arena

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: Nationwide Arena: 800 645 2657 or 614 246 3350 for hockey, 614 246 2000 for events. Chiller Dublin: 614 764 1000; Chiller Easton: 614 475 7575 Chiller North: 740 549 0009 Group Sales Information: For more information on group reservations or premium seating opportunities, call 614 246 7224
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Closed except on game or event days. Opens at 12 p.m. on game or event days.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Visa, Master Card, American Express & Discover
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call windows are located inside the Nationwide Arena Box Office at the southwest corner of Nationwide Blvd. and McConnell Blvd. Customer must present actual credit card, confirmation number and a photo ID.

venues.parkingDetail: There are more than 15,000 parking spaces available within a 10-minute walk of Nationwide Arena, including surface lots and parking garages. To purchase advanced parking, go to https://arenadistrict.parkmobile.io/.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: WHEELCHAIR ACCESS: Tickets available at all prices. Available at Ticketmaster, The Chillers and the Box Office. HEARING IMPAIRED: RF style assisted listening devices available through guest services at Nationwide Arena.

generalInfo.generalRule: Use of video cameras is prohibited within Nationwide Arena. For Blue Jackets games, professional cameras with attached lenses are permitted. For special events including concerts, the camera policies are determined by the show or tour. Generally, cameras are not permitted for special events, but please call (614)246-2000 with specific inquiries. Cameras with detachable lenses are not permitted at any time during special events. Bags are generally NOT permitted. There is an exception for medical bags, diaper bags OR clutches no larger than 8 inches x 5 inches x 1 inch. Medical bags, diaper bags AND clutches will be X-rayed via dedicated screening lines (identified at each entry). For more information visit https://www.nationwidearena.com/plan-your-visit.
generalInfo.childRule: Children ages 2 and over require a ticket for all Columbus Blue Jackets hockey games. Children under two years may enter without a ticket but must sit on the lap of a parent/guardian. Rules for children vary for other events at the Nationwide Arena. Check individual show for more information.

accessibility.info: Tickets for accessible seats may be sold to individuals who require accessible seating themselves or to someone purchasing on their behalf. For each accessible seat that is required, up to three additional accessible seats for companions may be purchased. Select the available seats (blue dots) designated with the accessibility symbol. The "Show accessible seats"  toggle emphasizes these accessible seats by changing the non-accessible seats to a lighter shade of blue (after pressing the Apply Filters button).  Additional non-accessible seats may be purchased at the same time by selecting those seats anywhere within Nationwide Arena. If you have any questions about purchasing accessible seating or companion seating, if you would like to purchase a larger number of seats, or if you would like to inquire about other accommodations, please contact our ticket sales and service general line at (614) 246-3350.

ticketLimit.info: There is a (6) ticket limit for all presales and a (9) ticket limit for public on-sale.
